title: Owner installs the agent on a small second Pi in the tent (later)
goal: The agent runs at boot on the tent Pi, wired to the sensors and relays, and talks to the hub on Calvary over the tailnet
acceptance: Steps 1-4 of the page give their expected result, or the difference is reported
Owner go-ahead for each run on the real rig (AGENTS.md, Hardware); the agent never switches hardware itself
Needs the second Pi bought and set up first (the page lists what Grover documents)
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: about 1 h on the tent Pi once it has the OS and Tailscale; buying and setting up the Pi is not included.
